## Review checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant existing code, documentation, and generated surfaces before changing them.
- [ ] The change and its tests form one focused unit.
- [ ] The full verification command passes, or I recorded each deferred or failing check above.
- [ ] I exercised the changed path end to end, including every affected consumer or platform.
- [ ] I updated affected docs, help text, examples, generated files, and changelog entries.
- [ ] I checked the diff for credentials, private data, unsafe input handling, and dependency risk.
- [ ] I recorded any defect found but not fixed in an issue.
